item.tib: dngos grub kun 'byung gi kha skong sbyin sreg 'bul thabs dgyes byed nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyig gter
item.coloph: de ltar byams ma dngos grub kun 'byung gi bsnyen bsgrab kha skong sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i thabs/ dgyes byed nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyig gter zhes/ tshul 'di zab mo'i lung dang mi 'gal bar/ rtse gcig byams ma bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ sgo rigs mkhan po nyi ma'i ming can gyis/ sa sprel nag zla'i dral tshes bzang po la/ gshen bstan sman gyi ri la sbyar ba dge/ sdebs nyes lung 'gal nor 'khrul ci mchis pa/ mchog gsum lha dang mkha' 'gror bzod par gsol/ dge bas 'di phyi'i don gnyis rab 'grub cing / bla med byams ma'i lha zhal mthong bar shog/
